def rotl8(x: uint8, k: int) -> uint8:
    """Rotate x left by k bits (0 <= k <= 7), wrapping the high bits around."""
    pre k >= 0 and k <= 7
    post bits.count_ones(out) == bits.count_ones(x)
    ex rotl8(129, 1) == 3
    ex rotl8(1, 7) == 128
    ex rotl8(255, 3) == 255
    ex rotl8(5, 0) == 5
    v = int(x)
    shifted = v << k
    low = shifted % 256
    high = shifted >> 8
    return wrap_as[uint8](low + high)
